mapper.select: SELECT pi."id", pd.id AS sku_id, pp.id AS purchase_id, pc.id AS cost_id, ps.id AS sale_id, ppk.id AS pack_id, pl.id AS logistics_id FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd."id" AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_cost pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_sale ps ON ps.sku_id = pd."id" AND ps.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_pack ppk ON ppk.sku_id = pd."id" AND ppk.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_logistics pl ON pl.sku_id = pd."id" AND pl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pd.id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pi."id", pd.images_url, pd.sku_no, pd.product_state, pd.name, pd.name_en, pi.name as spuName, pi.name_en as spuNameEn, pi.charge_name, pi.charge_id, pi.brand_name, pi.brand_id, pi.property, pi.property_id, pi.grade_id, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.category_id, pi.sale_method, pi.sell_spot, pi.function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials, pd.plan_listing_time, pd.first_mass_product_date, pd.unit_id, unit.name AS unit_name, pd.product_state, pi.entrusted_develop_cost, pi.mold_cost, pi.sample_fee, pi.is_customized, pi.sales_channel, pd.status FROM product_info pi LEFT JOIN product_detail pd on pi.id = pd.product_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_unit unit ON pd.unit_id = unit.id AND unit.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pi.id = #{productId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pi."id", pd.images_url, pd.sku_no, pd.product_state, pd.name, pd.name_en, pi.name as spuName, pi.name_en as spuNameEn, pi.charge_name, pi.charge_id, pi.brand_name, pi.brand_id, pi.property, pi.property_id, pi.grade_id, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.category_id, pi.sale_method, pi.sell_spot, pi.function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials, pd.plan_listing_time, pd.first_mass_product_date, pd.unit_id, unit.name AS unit_name, pd.product_state, pi.entrusted_develop_cost, pi.mold_cost, pi.sample_fee, pi.is_customized, pi.sales_channel, pd.status FROM product_info pi LEFT JOIN product_detail pd on pi.id = pd.product_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_unit unit ON pd.unit_id = unit.id AND unit.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pd.id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pi."id", pi.spu_no, pi."name", pi.name_en, pi.charge_name, pi.charge_id, pi.brand_name, pi.brand_id, pi.property, pi.property_id, pi.grade_id, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.category_id, pi.sale_method, pi.sell_spot, pi.function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials, pi.entrusted_develop_cost, pi.mold_cost, pi.sample_fee, pi.is_customized, pi.sales_channel FROM product_info pi WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pi.id = #{productId}

SELECT brand_id, brand_name, category_id, category AS categoryName FROM product_info pi LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pd.product_id = pi.id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.sku_no = #{sku} AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT pd.id AS sourceId, pd.product_id, pd.sku_no, pd.name FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.status = #{state} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')

SELECT id, product_id, sku_no, name, variant_property, plan_listing_time, unit_id, product_state, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id, images_url, unit_name, charge_id, charge_name, create_user_name, update_user_name, status, process_id, business_process_id, is_change, first_mass_product_date, sync_kingdee_status, sync_kingdee_time, version, is_deleted, sync_kingdee_id FROM product_detail

select pd.id as sku_id,pd.sku_no from product_info pi inner join product_detail pd on pd.product_id = pi.id where pi.property in('费用', '服务') and pd.status = 2 and pi.is_deleted = false and pd.is_deleted = false

SELECT pd.id AS skuId, pi.id AS productId, pi.spu_no, pi.name AS spuName, pd.sku_no, pd.images_url AS skuImagesUrl, pd.name AS skuName, pd.variant_property, pp.box_qty as unitQty, pl.declare_chinese_name as declareName, pl.declare_model as declareModel, ppu.main_supplier, ppu.second_supplier, pd.unit_name FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE left join product_pack pp on pd.id = pp.sku_id AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE left join product_logistics pl on pd.id = pl.sku_id AND pl.is_deleted = FALSE left join product_purchase ppu on pd.id = ppu.sku_id AND ppu.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND pd.status = #{status}
AND ( pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') OR pd.name ILIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') )
AND (pd.sku_no = #{skuNo} OR ppu.ean = #{skuNo})
